_comment: Classic-context entry points (content scripts, MV2 background, non-module MV3 workers) that currently ship ESM imports of shared Rollup chunks and would throw 'Cannot use import statement outside a module' at load. Keyed by extensions/<slug>. This baseline ratchets DOWN only: assert-self-contained.mjs fails on any NEW violation, and also fails if a listed entry has been fixed but not removed here. Burn entries down to {} by giving each extension per-entry self-contained (IIFE) builds.
